cues.text: Here are the tailoring questions customers ask the most, and good answers you can give when the tailor is not here.
How long will it take? Let me check our tailor’s schedule. Your ready date is on the ticket, and we’ll text you when it’s done.
How much will it cost? Let me look it up. The price is in our system, and I’ll tell you before we start.
Can you do it today? Let me check with our manager what’s possible. Rush jobs may cost extra.
Do I need to try it on? For length and fit, yes, so we can pin it. For buttons or zippers, no.
Can you make it bigger? It depends on the extra fabric inside. Our tailor will check and let you know.
Can you fix this hole? On a seam, usually yes. In the middle of the fabric, our tailor will look first.
Can you hem my wedding dress? Yes, our tailor will do a fitting with you. Let’s set a time.
Will it look exactly the same? Our tailor will make it look as close as possible. I’ll write down exactly what you want.
The golden rule: never guess a price, a date, or a result. Let me check and call you back is always a good answer.
